title: Broken Wings: Hornet Down
description:
Broken Wings: Hornet Down is a first person horror-adventure game set in a desert environment in the war-torn Afghanistan.

Explore your surroundings, interact with objects, unlock every part of the abandoned military complex. 

But most importantly, find a way to call for help or you might stay here forever.

The notes of the former inhabitants of the place will guide you through the unknown and will reveal the secrets of the previous war.

 

When the darkness falls, our hero is forced to seek shelter, however, his already desperate situation rapidly becomes much more sinister, as the history of the place comes alive.

During his struggle to explore the abandoned military complex, the story of another era unfolds. He quickly realizes he is not alone even though the outpost is empty for decades.

Who is this unknown creature?
description_short: Broken Wings: Hornet Down is an indie horror-adventure game in which the protagonist is Missing-in-Action over the war-torn Afghanistan. Explore your surroundings, discover the cursed past and find a way out.
